# Bali Zero

> > Indonesia's AI-powered visa and business setup agency specializing in KITAS, PT PMA, and Golden Visa services for expats and foreign investors in Bali.

Bali Zero is a comprehensive immigration and business services firm serving expats, investors, and entrepreneurs in Indonesia. The platform combines expert legal consultation with AI-powered tools like the KBLI Navigator to streamline visa applications, company registration, tax compliance, and property transactions.

## Key Topics

- KITAS (Limited Stay Permit)
- PT PMA (Foreign Investment Company)
- Golden Visa
- Indonesia Immigration
- KBLI (Business Classification)
- NPWP (Tax ID)
- OSS (Online Business Registration)
- BPJS (Social Insurance)
- Tax Compliance
- Company Setup
- Expat Relocation
- Foreign Investment
- Bali Business Services
- Work Permits
- Property Leasehold

## Core Services

- [Visa Services](https://www.balizero.com/services/visa): KITAS, KITAP, Visit, Investor, and Working permits for expats in Indonesia
- [Company Setup](https://www.balizero.com/services/company): PT PMA, PMDN, business licenses, and OSS registration services
- [Tax & BPJS Services](https://www.balizero.com/services/tax): NPWP registration, SPT filing, and BPJS insurance compliance
- [Real Estate Services](https://www.balizero.com/services/property): Leasehold agreements, foreign property ownership, and legal due diligence
- [All Services Overview](https://www.balizero.com/services): Complete service menu including KITAS, PT PMA, Golden Visa, and tax compliance

## Immigration & Visa Guides

- [Immigration & Visa Guides](https://www.balizero.com/immigration): Expert guides on KITAS, KITAP, Golden Visa, work permits, and retirement visa options
